verdict.rationale: Shopify documents multi-location operation: a centralized back office supporting 1,000+ locations, per-location inventory that syncs in real time, stock transfers between locations, and general reporting and analytics. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly shows per-location device assignment, per-location settings, or reporting broken down by location. Missing for 10: documented per-location device and fleet management, per-location settings configuration, location-level reporting breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration.
